newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICA NOON BONDS MORE CHEERFUL AS RAND TOPS OUT.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICA NOON BONDS MORE CHEERFUL AS RAND TOPS OUT.

text.p: 1010 GMT - Long bonds cheered, well off morning's weakest levels, as rand tops out after unit knocked earlier by London dollar buying.
* Benchmark R150 stock at 14.80 percent from 14.845 percent late on Wednesday and intraday weakest level of 14.87 percent.
* Failure to break 14.86 percent on the upside saw mkt withdraw to current stronger levels, debt traders say.
* Mainly offshore buying in morning session with local traders also covering shorts. Local institutions still seen lightening positions in follow-through from start of week.
* R150 perceived to have bottomed out at current levels for the day and seen hovering in afternoon.
* Rand hit by sizeable London dollar buy orders in early morning but then ran into Reserve Bank and exporter dollar selling which led to slight recovery.
* Last at 4.5140/5170 vs dlr from 4.5125/5155 overnight and intraday weakest of 4.5175.
* Seen churning in afternoon, and under renewed pressure from a variety of quarters on Friday.
